name: Ololand Dd
description: Institutional due diligence control system — 33 MCP tools for deal analysis, financial valuation (DCF, LBO, Monte Carlo), 246-category risk taxonomy, forensic QoE, cross-deal learning, and workflow orchestration for M&A professionals.
longDescription:
Ships **7 skills**, **1 agent**, **11 commands** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (7): `deal-sourcing` (Use when sourcing M&A or PE deals — discovering target companies from criteria, enriching with contact data, deduping…), `due-diligence` (Use when answering questions about M&A due diligence methodology, deal analysis frameworks, DD checklists, or when performing DD…), `financial-valuation` (Use when performing financial valuations, building DCF/LBO models, running Monte Carlo simulations, or analyzing comparable transactions), `risk-analysis` (Use when analyzing risks for M&A deals, evaluating risk severity, quantifying financial impact of risks, or building risk…), `setup` (Connect your OloLand account to Claude Code), `unit-economics` (Use when analyzing SaaS unit economics, cohort retention (NDR/GRR), LTV/CAC, CAC payback, magic number, or rule of 40), `welcome` (Show after first OloLand connection)
- **Agents** (1): `dd-analyst` (Autonomous due diligence analyst agent)
- **Commands** (11): `dd-analyze` (Run full due diligence analysis on a deal — financial extraction, risk assessment, valuation, and memo generation), `deal-search` (Search documents in a deal's data room — full-text + semantic search across uploaded PDFs, financials, legal docs), `new-deal` (Create a new deal from a company name or ticker — auto-fetches the latest 10-K and 5 years…), `risk-matrix` (Render the 246-category risk matrix as an interactive inline tile), `risk-report` (Generate a structured risk report for a deal — 246-category taxonomy with severity scoring, evidence links, and institutional…), `similar-deals` (Find similar completed deals from your firm's history — transfer learning insights, accuracy patterns, and valuation benchmarks), `source` (Source deals — discover targets, enrich contacts, dedupe against CRM, and draft personalized founder outreach), `talk-to-deal` (Ask a question about a deal and get a conversational, voice-optimized response — concise answers with rounded numbers…), and 3 more
- **MCP servers** (1): `ololand`

Installs with `claude plugin install ololand-dd@claude-community` from `ololand-ai/ololand-dd-plugin`.
